text:
Aisha: Noticed weird burst behavior in sample mobile app: same page cursor requested multiple times when auth refresh stalls.
Ben: Which SDK & version?
Aisha: Mobile uses JS bridge -> @redwood/sdk 2.3.0. Repro: open feed + toggle network + force token expiry. Two GETs for `?cursor=xyz` ~30ms apart, second gets 429.
Ravi: Sounds like prefetch + retry on auth refresh. Bridge spawns parallel calls for the same cursor.
Clara: Quick local fix: singleflight keyed by path+cursor. Keeps UX smooth and prevents thundering.
Ben: Can we add `dedupeInFlight` as opt-in in JS SDK and enable in sample-mobile? Keep default false to avoid surprises.
Ravi: Also add small random jitter on prefetch retry after auth so simultaneous refreshes don't replay together.
Aisha: I ran stress: 200 rapid opens with 1s auth latency -> 24% 429s before, 1% after dedupe + jitter.
Clara: Tests needed: concurrent callers, token refresh stub, memory leak when many unique cursors.
devex-bot: Created DEVEX-6320 "js-sdk: mobile sample dedupe + prefetch jitter" and assigned @Ravi.
Ben: Follow-up: audit desktop sample and quickstart to ensure similar patterns covered.
Aisha: I'll add short note to onboarding docs about prefetch settings and auth fragility.
Ravi: I'll draft PR tomorrow morning.
